# GTS head id

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:gtsHeadId`](gmeow-gtsHeadId.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/gtsHeadId>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)
- **Box roles:** [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The chain head of a segment — the content-id of its last frame, written 'blake3:<hex>'. Transitively commits to the segment's entire history (spec §9.1), making it a version fingerprint of the segment rather than a digest of its bytes: hence a subproperty of [`gmeow:versionFingerprint`](gmeow-versionFingerprint.md), distinct from [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md) (which is byte-exact identity and applies to the file or a blob as a whole). Functional: a segment has exactly one head.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:versionFingerprint`](gmeow-versionFingerprint.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:gtsHeadId`](gmeow-gtsHeadId.md) from [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to commit to a segment's entire history with a single chain head — the version-fingerprint identity used to cite a segment, build a document's composite identity, or keep a compaction source citable.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for byte-exact identity of the file or a blob (use [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md)) and avoid asserting more than one head per segment; the head is functional and commits transitively to the chain.

### How to use

- Record the last frame's content-id as 'blake3:<hex>'; order heads by [`gmeow:gtsSegmentIndex`](gmeow-gtsSegmentIndex.md) to form the document's identity, and keep the head on a derived-from source so old transport claims stay citable after compaction.
